comment: The three INV OUT modes are named Trig, InvGate and Double on the switch but DELAY, INVERTED and SHUFFLE in the code (QCDCore.cc:153-163). In Trig mode the trigger comes on the falling edge of the main gate (QCDCore.cc:306-311), which is why the panel calls the pulse-width knob a trigger delay. In Double mode a trigger comes on both edges (QCDCore.cc:312-316). The gate width leaves at least 5ms clear at each end of the period, or 30 per cent of the period for the INV OUT trigger below 100Hz (QCDCore.cc:165-176 and QCDCore.cc:276-284). The TAP OUT is 10V while every channel output is 5V (QCDCore.cc:660 and QCDCore.cc:349).
